annotations.title: Get the phone menu settings to paste

description: Read-only. What the CUSTOMER pastes into the settings of the extension in the Yemot HaMashiach management site, so that a call to that extension runs the app's phone sign-up form: { url, settings, text }, where settings is two lines (type=api and api_link=<url>) and text is the same in words for the customer. The link holds a secret key: hand it only to the app's owner, never post it publicly or put it in a page, a repository or a ticket. Set the form first with set_telephony_ivr_form. Needs the server to have phone forms on: a 404 means it is not enabled yet. Admin of the app.
